description: Election Commission - Declare as Members Wasudewan Randeep for Rattota P/S Aiyawu Manikkam for Matale M/C
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Rattota Pradeshiya Sabha and Matale Municipal Council) due to ceasing membership in a political alliance. This directly relates to electoral processes and changes in elected positions, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters related to local government elections and member status changes.
